# Unpaired Image-to-Image Translation using Cycle-Consistent Adversarial Networks

**Authors:** Jun-Yan Zhu, Taesung Park, Phillip Isola, Alexei A. Efros  
**Year:** 2017  
**Journal:** ICCV  
**DOI:** [10.1109/ICCV.2017.244](https://doi.org/10.1109/ICCV.2017.244)  
**Publisher:** [https://arxiv.org/abs/1703.10593](https://arxiv.org/abs/1703.10593)

**Keywords:** cyclegan, image-to-image

## Abstract

We present an approach for learning to translate an image from a source domain to a target domain without paired examples.
